**Indikator 7** is a national healthcare quality indicator in [[danmark|Danmark]] that measures the incidence of major bleeding among prevalent patients with [[atrieflimren]] [^src1]. It serves as a central quality metric in the Danish atrial fibrillation database reports because it directly evaluates the safety of anticoagulant treatment [^src1].

### Definition and Methodology
The indicator tracks major bleeding events, which are defined using adapted criteria from the [[international-society-of-thrombosis-and-hemostasis|International Society of Thrombosis and Hemostasis]] (ISTH) [^src2]. Specifically, a major bleeding event is identified as an acute hospital admission with bleeding, utilizing data from the [[landspatientregisteret|Landspatientregisteret]] [^src2]. The indicator is produced by the [[regionernes-kliniske-kvalitetsudviklingsprogram|Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram]] (RKKP) [^src2] and published by the [[sundhedsvaesenets-kvalitetsinstitut|Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut]] [^src4]. To facilitate geographic and administrative analysis, results are stratified by [[regioner|regioner]] and [[sundhedsklynger|Sundhedsklyngerne]], incorporating geospatial data from the [[geodatastyrelsen|Geodatastyrelsen]] [^src4]. Unlike some other metrics, Indikator 7 does not have a predefined target standard; rather, it functions as an ongoing surveillance tool to report incidence rates [^src5].

### Clinical and Epidemiological Findings
Data from the 2021/22 reporting period revealed that 2.2% of prevalent atrial fibrillation patients were admitted with major bleeding [^src1]. Despite an increased use of anticoagulant therapy over time, there has been no significant real development in this national proportion since the 2018–2019 period [^src1]. Regionally, the proportion of patients admitted with major bleeding varied between 1.9% and 2.3% [^src1]. 

A notable clinical challenge highlighted by the indicator is the distribution of bleeding events among low-risk patients: 43.7% of major bleeding events occurred in patients with a [[cha2ds2-vasc|CHA2DS2-VASc]] score of 0 or 1 [^src1]. When comparing specific anticoagulant therapies, the proportion of patients experiencing major bleeding was 2.33% for [[doac|DOAC]] and 2.44% for [[marevan|marevan]] [^src1]. Furthermore, for incident patients (measured one year after their diagnosis date), the national proportion of major bleeding was 3.1%, with regional variations ranging from 2.5% to 3.4% [^src1].

### Recent Performance and Trends
In the reporting period from July 1, 2023, to June 30, 2024, the national incidence of major bleeding was measured at 2.1% (95% CI: 2.1–2.2) [^src5]. The most recent data for the period from July 1, 2024, to June 30, 2025, shows a national incidence of 2.2% (95% CI: 2.1–2.3) [^src3]. Across the last three annual reporting periods, the data consistently shows no real national development in the proportion of major bleeding events, underscoring a stable but persistent risk associated with atrial fibrillation treatment [^src4].

## Timeline
- 2022-07-01: Start af opgørelsesperiode for Indikator 7 og Indikator 8 (indikator-7, indikator-8) [^src1]
- 2023-06-30: Afslutning af opgørelsesperiode for Indikator 7 og Indikator 8 (indikator-7, indikator-8) [^src1]
- 2021/22: Indikator 7 beregnet for perioden 2021/22 med andele på 2,2% nationalt og 1,9–2,5% regionalt (indikator-7) [^src1]
- 2022/23: Indikator 7 beregnet for perioden 2022/23 med andele på 2,2% nationalt og 1,9–2,5% regionalt (indikator-7) [^src1]
- 01.07.2023 - 30.06.2024: Indikator 7 beregnet for perioden 01.07.2023 - 30.06.2024 med national andel på 2,2% og regional variation 1,9–2,2% (indikator-7) [^src5]
- 2024-07-01: Start af målingsperiode for Indikator 1, Indikator 2, Indikator 3, Indikator 4b, Indikator 5, Indikator 6, Indikator 7 og Indikator 15 (indikator-1, indikator-2, indikator-3, indikator-4b, indikator-5, indikator-6, indikator-7, indikator-15) [^src3]
- 01.07.2024 - 30.06.2025: Aktuel opgørelsesperiode for Indikator 7 (indikator-7) [^src3]
- 2023/24: Tidligere opgørelsesperiode for Indikator 7 (indikator-7) [^src5]
- 2022/23: Tidligere opgørelsesperiode for Indikator 7 (indikator-7) [^src1]
